label: vocr6-spotter2
registered_before: any textspot8 read: MeikiOCR's benchmark, the geometry diagnostic and every student run
what: MeikiOCR's text detector as the reference line spotter (step 1), a crop-geometry diagnostic on hval (step 2), then a <= 500 KB int8 spotter distilled from it for Rubi's plain-C runtime (step 3, arms by amendment 1 before any training run), decided by textspot6's rule with two guards (step 4)

pagepath.note: textspot6's pin (main 8a71eec + vocr6-finder #135 2d3971b, its libvocr.so built): every number pairs with textspot6's

dev.note: #119's 1,161 whole-dialogue units, 93 VNs; the headline leaves v12188 (hooked title PCSG00576) out: 92 VNs, 1,143 units

hval.note: 6,327 units of 46 train titles' hval pages (textspot6's)

meiki_detector.input: BGR (cv2's order, as teacher/label.py and textspot6's cache feed it); MeikiOCR's preprocessing: fit to 960 x 544 INTER_LINEAR, /255, top-left padded

pins.baselines: textspot6's stored page-path results ($A/vocr6-spotter/eval/: grad_refine = --finder rubi, grad_refine_fix1 = rubi,fix=1 (Rubi's finder since Rubi_for_vita#330), textspot6's runs and textspot3's pick), read with the same pins

step1_meiki_benchmark.frames: eval/textspot8.py meiki-spot: dev (#119's units' frames, console view: PSP at 2x bilinear on the colour), hval (the hval pages, views vita / psp2x / psp), tsdev (textspot's 188 development frames); every box with score > 0.2 kept

decodes.pad: grown by 4 px on every side (2 px on a native PSP view)
decodes.ink: refined to ink as textspot2 refines meiki boxes (refine_h / refine_t, P1) then grown by the same pad

step1_meiki_benchmark.page_path: each decode as det (the horizontal boxes whose centre lies in a unit's region, clipped: eval/textspot6.py pagepath-boxes --decode det) and det+refine (VOCR_REFINE_DEFAULT on the frame: --decode detref), on dev and hval through the pinned eval/pagepath.py
step1_meiki_benchmark.primary: the reference row of record is the decode (of the six) with the lowest hval page-path dialogue CER; hval only, never dev; every decode is reported
step1_meiki_benchmark.metrics: page-path dialogue CER (dev headline without v12188, Vita / PSP, hval), pagepath's line recall (whole lines / lines), box precision (non-junk boxes / boxes) and their F1 on dev and hval units, eval/textspot6.py hval-boxes (P / R / F1 against the verified lines per view) and tsdev (textspot's F1, all-text and dialogue CER), the per-VN errors against GRAD + refine, rubi,fix=1 and textspot6's representatives, the detector's file size and parameter count, host ms per frame at 1 and 5 threads
step1_meiki_benchmark.intervals: eval/pagepath.py compare: paired, 10,000 cluster-bootstrap resamples, seed 0 (VNs on dev, titles on hval)
step1_meiki_benchmark.role: a reference only (not a candidate: 14.5 MB of float32 ONNX cannot run on a Vita)

step2_geometry_diagnostic.what: how much the crop margin costs the recognizer, on hval only (train titles, the screening set)
arms: rubi,fix=1's boxes grown by 1 and 2 px vertically (shift-boxes --dy 1, 2) and by 4 px horizontally (--dx 4)
textspot6 base_t64n8c16_seed1 det boxes shrunk by 1 and 2 px vertically
textspot6 base_qS4_seed2 crop boxes shrunk by 1 and 2 px vertically
step2_geometry_diagnostic.role: report only; it chooses the student's target geometry (amendment 1)

step3_student: registered by amendment 1 before any training run: shapes, data (frames and their exclusions), targets, recipe, seeds 1-3

rule.eligible: VTSP bytes <= 512,000, est. ms @333 per 960 x 544 frame <= 300 (textspot6's A9 cycle model, eval/textspot6_a9.py, plus any decode step's cost), arena <= 262,144, C == twin on every development frame
rule.representative: each arm and decode: its median seed of 3 by unseen-dev page-path dialogue CER (never the best)
rule.beats_grad_refine: unseen dev (without v12188): page-path dialogue CER difference (candidate - GRAD + refine) with a VN-cluster 95% interval entirely below 0; hval: the difference not resolved above 0 (textspot6's rule, unchanged)
rule.guard_confirmation: not resolved worse (95% VN-cluster interval not entirely above 0) than rubi,fix=1 on vocr6-spotter3's fresh confirmation set (>= 40 VNs no spotter trained on), read once per candidate set at the end
rule.cost_order: VTSP bytes, est. ms @333, arena, decode (crop, crop+refine, det, det+refine, then any registered decode), then the name
rule.pick: the cheapest qualifier; a costlier qualifier replaces it when, against it, unseen-dev page-path CER is resolved below 0 and hval is not resolved above 0; repeated until none does
rule.rubi_default: the pick becomes Rubi's default line picker only if, against rubi,fix=1 on the same units, unseen dev is resolved below 0 and hval not resolved above 0 (and the confirmation guard holds); otherwise it ships behind a setting that is off by default. Only one spotter is Rubi's default: if vocr6-spotter3's pick also qualifies, the better of the two under this test, agreed with vocr6-spotter3 and vocr6-lead before any Rubi merge
rule.no_qualifier: negative verdict; the eligible representative with the lowest unseen-dev page-path CER is released as a research pre-release; no Rubi PR
rule.with_pick: retrain the pick on train + guard + hval (same recipe and seed) -> pre-release with SHA256SUMS, the test sets read once (report only), a normal Rubi_for_vita PR (memory ledger exact, both Vita builds, the fast gate, an off-switch defaulting to the measured best, GRAD as the fallback on low confidence) merged under Rubi's rules, then TEST_READY for rubi-test-consolidate's single test build

test: after the selection commit only, once: the hooked test title (PCSG00807) through the page path, CLANNAD and vita-test + psp-test as whole frames, as eval/textspot6_test.py reads them; Meiki's benchmark never reads a protected set
estimates: console times are textspot6's A9 cycle-model estimates at 333 and 444 MHz; nothing runs on a console
disclosures: the student's design (target geometry, augmentation for side-by-side choices, translucent boxes and tight regions) is informed by textspot6's per-VN analysis of the same unseen-dev units; the confirmation set guards against the resulting optimism
the geometry diagnostic reads hval only
